explanation: The dataset-change route now names the HYPOMAP Visium reference atlas: scripts/build_visium_reference.mts builds public/expression/visium/ from the donor x region extract tracked in data/expression/visium/, --fetch re-extracts it from the pinned RDS with scripts/extract_visium_reference.R, and its groups are regions so summaries use regionalSummary rather than a donor spread. The shared writer header lists Visium.
